title: Decision Models as Judges for Hallucination Detection
abstract: arXiv:2610.37229v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models are widely used as judges of model outputs (LLM-as-a-Judge), but they are costly and can hallucinate or be overconfident. Decision models are a potential alternative. They return a predefined verdict with a probability for each label instead of free-form text and are much cheaper and faster. We test this promise on hallucination detection. We build binary benchmarks for five hallucination types (9,852 items from six datasets) and compare five decision models with the generative judge gpt-6-sol. Performance depends strongly on the type: the best decision model matches gpt-6-sol in balanced accuracy on context inconsistency and comes within 3 percentage points on factual errors, but trails it by 4-8 points on logical and instruction inconsistency. translated_title: 决策模型作为幻觉检测的裁判
translated_abstract: 大语言模型被广泛用作模型输出的裁判（LLM-as-a-Judge），但它们成本高昂，且可能产生幻觉或表现得过于自信。决策模型是一种潜在的替代方案：它们针对每个标签返回带有概率的预定义判定结果，而非自由格式的文本，并且成本低得多、速度更快。我们在幻觉检测任务上检验了这一承诺。我们为五种幻觉类型构建了二分类基准（来自六个数据集的9,852个样本），并将五个决策模型与生成式裁判 gpt-6-sol 进行比较。性能在很大程度上取决于幻觉类型：最佳决策模型在上下文不一致方面的平衡准确率与 gpt-6-sol 相当，在事实错误方面相差不到3个百分点，但在逻辑不一致和指令不一致方面落后4-8个百分点。决策模型输出的概率过于自信，尽管程度轻于 GPT-6 模型，且只能中等程度地区分正确与错误的决策。我们还发现一个 conf…（摘要截断）
tldr: 该研究构建了覆盖五种幻觉类型的二分类基准，系统评估了决策模型作为低成本幻觉检测裁判的可行性，发现其最佳模型在部分幻觉类型上可媲美生成式大模型裁判，但在其他类型上仍有4-8个百分点差距，且概率校准仍偏过度自信。
en_tdlr: This study builds binary benchmarks across five hallucination types to systematically evaluate decision models as low-cost judges for hallucination detection, showing that the best decision model matches gpt-6-sol on some hallucination types but trails by 4-8 points on others, while its probabilities remain overconfident.
